# Valicon

Source: https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.md

# `Valicon`
[🔗](https://github.com/starfish-codes/valicon/blob/v1.9.2/lib/valicon.ex#L1)

  The collection of ectoless validation and helper functions for validation
  of pure data structures.

# `key`

```elixir
@type key() :: atom() | String.t()
```

# `run_validations`

```elixir
@spec run_validations(map() | list(), [
  (map() | list() -&gt;
     [Valicon.ValidationError.t()] | Valicon.ValidationError.t())
]) :: [Valicon.ValidationError.t()]
```

  Runs the given validations on the given attributes.

# `validate`

```elixir
@spec validate(map() | list(), [
  (map() | list() -&gt;
     [Valicon.ValidationError.t()] | Valicon.ValidationError.t())
]) :: {:ok, map() | list()} | {:error, [Valicon.ValidationError.t()]}
```

  Validates the given attributes with the given validations.

---

*Consult [api-reference.md](api-reference.md) for complete listing*

# Valicon.Conversions

Source: https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.Conversions.md

# `Valicon.Conversions`
[🔗](https://github.com/starfish-codes/valicon/blob/v1.9.2/lib/valicon/conversions.ex#L1)

  Data transformation functions. Pretty generic but used mostly before calling the validations.

# `atomize_keys`

```elixir
@spec atomize_keys(map(), [atom()]) :: map()
```

# `atomize_value`

```elixir
@spec atomize_value(map(), Valicon.key(), [atom()]) :: map()
```

# `cast`

```elixir
@spec cast(map(), Keyword.t()) ::
  {:ok, map()} | {:error, [Valicon.ConversionError.t()]}
```

  Casts the string values inside the attrs map to the given types.

  ## Examples

      iex> cast(%{name: "Butterfree", number: "012"}, [name: :string, number: :integer])
      {:ok, %{name: "Butterfree", number: 12}}

# `downcase_in`

```elixir
@spec downcase_in(map(), atom()) :: map()
```

# `parse`

```elixir
@spec parse(String.t(), :date) :: {:ok, Date.t()} | {:error, atom()}
@spec parse(String.t(), :datetime) :: {:ok, DateTime.t()} | {:error, atom()}
@spec parse(String.t(), :integer) :: {:ok, integer()} | {:error, :bad_integer}
@spec parse(String.t(), :boolean) :: {:ok, boolean()} | {:error, :bad_boolean}
@spec parse(String.t() | [String.t()], :list) :: {:ok, [String.t()]}
@spec parse(String.t(), :string) :: {:ok, String.t()}
```

# `parse_boolean`

```elixir
@spec parse_boolean(term()) :: {:ok, boolean()} | {:error, :bad_boolean}
```

# `parse_datetime`

```elixir
@spec parse_datetime(term()) :: {:ok, DateTime.t()} | {:error, atom()}
```

# `parse_float`

```elixir
@spec parse_float(term()) :: {:ok, float()} | {:error, :bad_float}
```

# `parse_integer`

```elixir
@spec parse_integer(term()) :: {:ok, integer()} | {:error, :bad_integer}
```

# `parse_list`

```elixir
@spec parse_list(String.t() | [String.t()]) ::
  {:ok, [String.t()]} | {:error, :bad_list}
```

# `parse_string`

```elixir
@spec parse_string(term()) :: {:ok, String.t()} | {:error, :bad_string}
```

# `rename_key`

```elixir
@spec rename_key(map(), Valicon.key(), Valicon.key()) :: map()
```

# `stringify_keys`

```elixir
@spec stringify_keys(map()) :: map()
@spec stringify_keys(list()) :: list()
@spec stringify_keys(term()) :: term()
```

# `transform`

```elixir
@spec transform(map(), list()) :: map()
```

# `transform_in`

```elixir
@spec transform_in(map(), atom(), (term() -&gt; term())) :: map()
```

# `trim_whitespaces`

```elixir
@spec trim_whitespaces(any()) :: any()
```

# `upcase_in`

```elixir
@spec upcase_in(map(), atom()) :: map()
```

---

*Consult [api-reference.md](api-reference.md) for complete listing*

# Valicon.Validations

Source: https://valicon.hexdocs.pm/Valicon.Validations.md

# `Valicon.Validations`
[🔗](https://github.com/starfish-codes/valicon/blob/v1.9.2/lib/valicon/validations.ex#L1)

  The different validations that can be applied to the attributes.

# `fqdn_valid?`

```elixir
@spec fqdn_valid?(String.t()) :: boolean()
```

# `validate_base64_url_fields`

```elixir
@spec validate_base64_url_fields(map(), [Valicon.key()], String.t()) :: [
  Valicon.ValidationError.t()
]
```

# `validate_boolean_fields`

# `validate_datetime`

```elixir

]
```

